svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How the desk works together
svg.desc: Mac Studio Prepared: 120 seats in the groups the desk's app draws, each shown by its avatar, with the flow from command and intake through the research floor and the checks to the investment team and operations.
svg.text: Every face is one seat, with its own harness, its own sandbox and its own written workflow.
The head of the floor routes every task to the seat that owns it.
Staff: chief of staff, devil's advocate, scorekeeper and costs.
News, filings, mail and calls, screened as they arrive, one item at a time.
Whole public files, checked and dated.
Licences, quality and the model scout.
The analyst leads. Each note is checked before it leaves the floor.
PM, CIO, risk and compliance approve,
send and trade. Nobody else can.
After the trade: reconciled, explained, cash and tax.
anything that needs a person goes back
Alongside: everything here is a draft or a proposal
The only route to the cloud,
Source: Mac Studio Prepared floor plan, November 2026. 109 agents, plus 11 always on engines shown in grey.
Blue: work that needs a person goes back. The minifigure avatars are fan made; the characters belong to their owners.
